dapps.name: Seedbound
dapps.description: Quantum-resistant file encryption with multi-node access grants via Maxima
dapps.about:
Seedbound turns your Minima node into a personal quantum-resistant encryption vault. Files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and signed with W-OTS+ — Minima's native quantum-resistant signature — while the AES key itself is bound to your node's seed phrase via the `seedrandom` primitive. You never see, store, or transmit a key.

Share access with any number of nodes via Maxima — each recipient gets their own grant block bound to their own seed. Either party can decrypt on their own node; nobody hands over a key.

Built for lawyers, journalists, medical professionals, and privacy-conscious users who handle sensitive files and cannot afford key loss or unauthorized access. Works fully locally — no servers, no cloud, no data ever leaves your machine.
dapps.release_notes:
### v1.0.1 — April 6, 2026

- First public release
- AES-256-GCM file encryption with W-OTS+ quantum-resistant signature
- Multi-Bound access system: share decryption with multiple Minima nodes via independent grant blocks
- P2P grant delivery over Maxima
- Persistent grant index via Minima H2 SQL
- Supports files up to ~100 MB
